PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1.05-1.09, hemoglobin 10.9-11.6, platelets 288-296, sodium 139, wbc 8-8.6; vitals dbp 65-69, heart_rate 80-84, map 86-91, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 129-136, spo2 96-98, temp 36.9-37.2
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Transfuse 1 unit packed red blood cells
Assessment and plan: Upper GI bleed. Hypertension. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 62-year-old male, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Upper GI bleed. Hypertension. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
